status: Analysis choices fixed after source metadata review and before inspecting GSE144424 marker effects; not an external preregistration.
purpose: Exploratory external donor validation of the existing AC16 human oxygen-response marker directions; not model training or a replacement frozen benchmark.
expected_primary_direction: positive for all eight, specified by the preceding AC16 analysis
primary_contrast: B-A: six hours at 1% versus the matched 10% reference, both harvested at experiment hour 6
primary_selection: One complete A-D experiment per donor: published experiment 2 for 18511, 18852 and 18855; sole experiment 1 for all other donors. Expected 15 donors and 60 profiles.
normalization: Library-size median-of-ratios: autosomal genes having strictly positive counts in every selected profile define the geometric-mean reference; median gene ratio per sample, rescaled to geometric mean 1. Apply log2(count/size_factor + 1). Fit independently within each prespecified sample selection. Never pool GSE144424 and Tsao expression.
primary_estimates: Per-gene donor-paired log2 normalized-count differences; n positive/zero/negative, mean, median, and percentile 95% donor-bootstrap interval for the median (20,000 resamples, seed 144424). Intervals are unadjusted and conditional on the observed normalization.
primary_tests: One-sided exact sign tests against positive probability 0.5; exclude exact zero ties from test denominator but report them; Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across all eight specified markers. Call donor-direction support at q <= 0.05 and positive median; report individual markers rather than optimizing a panel or post-hoc donor-consistency threshold.
secondary_interpretation: Descriptive only: per-donor changes, median and bootstrap interval. Report proportion with abs(C-A) or abs(D-A) < abs(B-A), residual positive/negative signs, and overshoot. These are expression proximity to an earlier reference, not functional recovery; later time-matched normoxia controls are absent.

sensitivities.repeat_averaged_qc: Use all complete A-D experiments except the original H18852 experiment 1, which contains the published H18852_A outlier and H18852_D with undetermined RIN. Compute matched experiment deltas first, then mean within donor. Expected 20 experiments/80 profiles/15 donors, with every donor equally weighted.
sensitivities.repeat_averaged_all: Include all 21 complete A-D experiments/84 profiles, including the flagged H18852 original experiment, with the same equal-donor aggregation.
sensitivities.primary_cpm: Same primary 60 profiles, using log2(autosomal-library CPM + 1) rather than median-ratio normalized counts. Report direction stability without choosing the preferred normalization from the results.

abundance_reporting: Retain all specified markers. Report normalized-count medians in A/B; flag markers with both medians below 10 rather than discarding them after seeing effects.
limits: GSE144424 is donor-derived human iPSC cardiomyocyte cultures, not AC16 or mouse HL-1; it cannot independently validate HL-1 or isolate species effects.
The reference is 10%, not Tsao 20%; there is no matching sustained-1% arm and Tsao exposure durations/independent culture identities are unknown.
TPM contrasts and normalized-count contrasts have different scales; compare directions, not their magnitudes or pooled absolute values.
The count matrix is not the paper's TMM/RUV-adjusted differential-expression result. This analysis does not reproduce its model, fit RUV factors, or perform genome-wide DE.
Culture purity and technical effects may contribute; repeated experiments are not additional independent donors.
Existing frozen datasets, splits, protocols, models, benchmarks and demo remain unchanged. AC16 already occurs in existing oxygen TEST splits; these inspected data are not a new blind evaluation.
